import sys, random, time, importlib.util
from array import array
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("submain", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def brute(items, full):
    items = [(mk & full, c, q) for mk,c,q in items]
    n=len(items); size=1<<n
    unions = array('I', bytes(4*size)); costs = array('H', bytes(2*size))
    best=None
    for mk in range(size):
        if mk:
            low=mk&-mk; i=low.bit_length()-1; prev=mk^low
            u=unions[prev]|items[i][0]; unions[mk]=u
            c=costs[prev]+items[i][1]; costs[mk]=c
        else: u=0;c=0
        if u==full:
            key=(c,mk.bit_count())
            if best is None or key<best: best=key
    return best

random.seed(20240915)
worst=0.0
for trial in range(4000):
    npairs = random.randint(1, 12)
    n = random.randint(1, 14)
    cost_hi = random.choice([1,2,3,5,1000])
    items = []
    for i in range(n):
        mask = random.getrandbits(npairs)
        if mask == 0: mask = 1 << random.randrange(npairs)
        items.append((mask, random.randint(1,cost_hi), "q%02d"%i))
    cov = 0
    for it in items: cov |= it[0]
    full = (1<<npairs)-1
    if cov != full: continue
    t0=time.time()
    sol = m._solve_cover(items, full, npairs)
    dt = time.time()-t0
    worst = max(worst, dt)
    b = brute(items, full)
    assert sol is not None
    assert (sol[0], sol[1]) == b, (trial, npairs, n, cost_hi, sol, b, items)
    assert len(set(sol[2])) == len(sol[2])
    assert sol[0] == sum(i[1] for i in items if i[2] in set(sol[2]))
print("4000 random solver instances OK, worst %.3fs" % worst)
PYEOF
